components.name: Task-list row
components.description: Synthetic task row with the shipped tablet two-row layout and mobile flex stack. Status is visible at every width.
components.css: .ds-task-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,2.3fr) minmax(100px,1fr) minmax(150px,1.3fr) minmax(100px,.8fr);align-items:center;gap:20px;width:100%;padding:18px 12px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#e3e5e9);background:transparent;color:var(--foreground,#20232a);font:400 14px/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-task-row:hover{background:var(--soft,#f2f3f5)}.ds-task-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#6836d5);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-task-title{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:7px 12px}.ds-task-title strong{width:100%;order:-1;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600}.ds-task-number{font-family:'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2px;color:var(--faint,#626873)}.ds-task-source{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:var(--muted,#626873);font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}.ds-task-source svg{color:#73a387}.ds-task-project{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#626873)}.ds-task-action{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:13px}.ds-action-indicator{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;flex-shrink:0}.ds-task-stage{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#626873)}.ds-task-stage>svg{margin-left:auto}.ds-stage-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border:1.5px solid #aaa99f;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}@media(max-width:1200px){.ds-task-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,2fr) minmax(130px,1fr) 110px}.ds-task-project{display:none}}@media(min-width:681px) and (max-width:900px){.ds-task-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto}.ds-task-title{grid-column:1/-1}}@media(max-width:680px){.ds-task-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:20px 0}.ds-task-title{width:100%}.ds-task-title strong{font-size:16px}.ds-action-indicator,.ds-task-stage>svg{display:none}}

narrative.overview:
2DIGITS Developmentwerkplek is a personal workspace for reading client requests and deciding what happens next. White documents, cool neutral navigation and restrained purple actions keep the task text prominent. The interface uses Dutch labels and the official 2DIGITS favicon beside a text wordmark.

System UI typography supports daily operational reading. The default task list uses separators, and an opened ticket becomes a full-page document with an action column. Project boards and settings keep their existing bordered containers.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral reading backgrounds in light and dark themes.
System UI sans with readable content and metadata.
Flat task rows and document sections.
Purple actions, focus outlines and active-tab underlines.
Next actions and workflow status remain visible at narrow widths.

rules.name: The restrained accent Rule
rules.body: Keep task rows and ticket sections neutral; use purple for actions, focus and selection indicators.

rules.name: The readable metadata Rule
rules.body: Use the implemented 13px metadata size for task, source and execution information.

dos: Do use the final stylesheet cascade when extending the task list or ticket workspace.
Do keep the written workflow status visible beside or below the next action.
Do preserve the project-settings shortcut through 1000px when the supporting action sections disappear.
Do preserve source whitespace, readable line lengths and underlined original-source links.
Do use theme variables for controls and document backgrounds.
Do keep keyboard focus visible on rows, buttons, fields and tabs.
donts: Don't replace the system UI stack with the brand's marketing typography.
Don't wrap every ticket section in a rounded card.
Don't use workflow color as the only status label.
Don't inherit earlier tiny metadata sizes or unused eyebrow styles as new design rules.
Don't treat synthetic review captures as an approved visual comp.
